entityFieldPolicy: All8 canonical Driver records,16 RELATED_SEARCH aliases and empty crosswalk reviewed. Frozen definitions, mechanisms, source references, scales, data types, polarity/direction, modifiability, volatility, onset/time/persistence, indicators, methods, observability, caveats and narrative/interactions preserved. Zero local blocked fields; no fields repaired.
rdsReview: No local RDS and no RDS endpoint among15incident edges. PSY-078 remains F09 protected RDS. Conceptual resource complement in PSY-057/058 is a scientific issue, not authorization to reclassify either Driver or encode formula causation.
causalGateReview: STANDARD_CAUSAL throughout. Person→small-group REL-PSY-067 needs level-transition mechanism/evidence; no PRC-085 mediation inferred. Prior BIO/INF proposals are pointers only.

layersConsidered.BIO: Sleep/fatigue and cognitive performance reviewed through prior pilot and task literature; no BIO revisions or physiological-to-subjective equivalence.
layersConsidered.PSY: Attention, resources, motivation, ease and task learning reviewed with state/trait, latent/task and within/between-person distinctions.
layersConsidered.SOC: Exclusion/inclusion/gaze and participation contexts; real contact, perceived exclusion and gaze behavior differ.
layersConsidered.CUL: Chua country-group viewing comparison is observational and lacks exact cultural-Driver mapping.
layersConsidered.ENV: Noise/task-dependent performance literature; perception and occupied load not inferred from performance alone.
layersConsidered.INS: Scarcity/financial-problem cues and institutional task assignment considered; cue is not income/policy change.
layersConsidered.INF: Signaling, framing, ambiguity and emotional-content evidence/legacy sources reviewed with exact recipient targets.
layersConsidered.TEC: Computerized n-back, visual cues and display differences; interface operation is not guaranteed psychological change.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Visual cues, n-back practice, mindfulness and framing screened; two operation-only identities.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Multitasking, information selection, practice and daily contact considered; no uncontrolled activity causal effect inferred.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Scarcity/disruption/noise and sleep contexts; occurrence does not establish exact cognitive consequence.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Noise and visual surroundings reviewed, distinguishing content from sensory exposure.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Assignment/financial context and constraints considered; no institutional policy effect inferred from a cue.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Display cues/fonts and computerized practice, not universal platform efficacy.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Exclusion/inclusion and group communication examined; no social-tie/PSYWERX-Relationship confusion.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Cue, framing, ambiguity, emotional content and disfluency reviewed.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Fatigue and sleep effects versus current resource measures; no diagnosis or physiological proxy substitution.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Cueing and social/cultural viewing effects are promising but no exact proportion contrast extracted; no signed whole-attention effect.
driverLedgers.gaps: Dwell-time proportion requires an explicit denominator and relevant region/window; fixation count, first-fixation latency and covert allocation are different measures.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Heterogeneous tasks, learners, exposure windows and comparators. Reach/subgroups/intended versus observed effects considered; no quantitative transfer, benefit criterion or practitioner recommendation. Synergy/antagonism/thresholds/functional shape not extracted; nonsignificance not supported null.

relationshipPropertyReview: All15 exact edges reviewed or linked to earlier primary review before PassB. Need-for-cognition/knowledge/capacity moderation screened; no exact scoped edge-target effect or independent interaction identified. No B/C overlap claim, no pathway from reachability/meta-regression, no alteration of BIO-F01 B04 or INF-F03 proposal.
propertyPolicy: All11 properties considered. LEVEL UNKNOWN for two RN effects; no numeric ordinal direction for nominal PSY-060. OTHER_SPECIFIED exists in AE V1 but free-text specification alone is not evidence of adopted category or automatic typed-category validation. No new AE target or schema change needed to record an honest research question.
identityReview: Compared production14HappeningTypes/9Interventions and prior8Layer identities. Instructional non-content visual cue and n-back updating practice are not content simplification, film exposure, uncertainty bounds, task-option choice or social contact changes. Existing overnight sleep-loss and Cyberball identities recognized without duplicates. No efficacy or permission embedded.

skepticalReview.method: Second pass separate from candidate drafting challenged proxy validity, exact comparator, canonical source identity, task transfer and primary-source/review independence. Both retained effects remain research-needed, UNKNOWN and ineligible.
checks: Source171 title/year/PMID mismatch and SRC340 exact reuse caught before closeout; original disfluency experiment and its replication pool not independent evidence.
Mixed effort/difficulty ratings do not establish exact resource occupancy. Fixation count/duration do not silently become attention proportion.
N-back-specific transfer, treated-control far-transfer null and no evidence of broad availability retained.
Mindfulness active-control and accuracy/latency disagreements preserved; psychological acceptance not cognitive flexibility.
Nominal frame has no universal scalar increase; no direct RDS/state target and no scenario operation treated as scientific evidence.
Existing BIO/INF revision-review proposals linked once; no previous pilot record changed or new parallel proposal.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Abstract-level access for much landscape evidence and some unresolved canonical bibliographic alignments. Detailed cue contrast, task-to-construct measurement and transfer remain future research, not activatable science.
